title: The Saturday Market (Il mercato del sabato)

scenes.title: Due cesti e una lista
scenes.summary: After Graham restores kitchen power, Hannah and Tessa grab woven baskets to shop at the Saturday neighborhood market while Graham rewires Room 9.

scenes.title: Limoni profumati e miele dorato
scenes.summary: At the bustling Saturday market, Tessa teaches Hannah how to choose fragrant lemons and honey when Owen spots them and helps carry the heavy jars.

scenes.title: Dodici tazze bianche
scenes.summary: Caleb meets the group at the market pottery stall and helps Hannah and Tessa choose thick white stoneware cups that keep tea hot.

scenes.title: Giovedì significa oggi?
scenes.summary: Back at the inn, Arthur proudly tells Graham about the bargain cafe chairs he ordered, then realizes he circled Saturday instead of Thursday.

scenes.title: Una montagna di sedie
scenes.summary: Hannah and Tessa return from the market to find Arthur trapped behind towers of unpainted folding chairs blocking the courtyard path.

scenes.title: Luce nella camera nove
scenes.summary: Using the black tape from the market, Graham finishes the new copper wiring and switches on the warm glass ceiling lamp in Room 9.

scenes.title: Dentro il coperchio del pianoforte
scenes.summary: Under the new ceiling lamp, Evelyn, Hannah, and Caleb pull a folded sheet of handwritten piano music from behind the wooden music rest.

scenes.title: Chiedete al registro di mia zia
scenes.summary: Evelyn shows Arthur the unfinished handwritten waltz, and Arthur recognizes his late aunt's handwriting right as the city clerk leaves an urgent message.
